name: Back lever
description: A face-down horizontal hold under a bar or rings with the arms behind you. Shoulder mobility comes first, then the lever is lengthened step by step.

steps.label: German hang
steps.cue: Go only as deep as stays pain free; never bounce.

steps.label: Skin the cat
steps.cue: Move slowly through the bottom and keep your arms straight.

steps.label: Tuck back lever
steps.cue: Press your hands down so your shoulders stay level.

steps.label: Advanced tuck back lever
steps.cue: Push your hips back until your back is flat.

steps.label: Straddle back lever
steps.cue: Squeeze your glutes so your lower back does not sag.

steps.label: Full back lever
steps.cue: Legs together, body straight, arms locked.
